## What's new in BruFin 0.4

### Manage your categories

- Add and remove expense and income categories in **Settings → Categories**.
- Restore the standard category list at any time.
- Custom categories are available in transaction entry, income and expense filters, and recurring bill setup.
- Removing a category takes it out of future choices while preserving the labels on existing transactions and recurring bills.

### Your settings stay portable

- Category lists are stored on your device and are included in BruFin JSON backups.
- Custom categories use BruFin's matching color and icon styling throughout the app.

### Android build

- This release includes an Android debug APK built by GitHub Actions. The APK is unsigned for production distribution.
